verdict_ko: 생산 helper 변경이나 mode 초기화의 새로운 결함은 확인하지 않았습니다. 원문과 test-only bridge의 경계, 조건부 입력 해석 및 12개 사례 비교는 타당합니다. 다만 oracle은 선언한 오차범위의 대수 비교이며 정확한 native-kind 비트 재생은 아닙니다. 물리 단위·PSD/LUT와 전체 Thompson 초기화는 미승인입니다.

source_scope.bridge: Thompson test-only setter writes is_aerosol_aware and obmr=1/bm_r, returns existing constants; UDM constants bridge only reads constants after real udminit. Marked insertions are reversible and snapshot() requires byte-exact stripping.
source_scope.observation: Hooks follow actual cloud radius assignment, record density/mass/number/slope/radius; OFF capture returns immediately.
source_scope.initialization_claim: Full module compilation with dependency stubs and dead-section linking is not full WRF initialization. thompson_init is not called and is explicitly reported as zero. Labels 8/28 indicate controlled private kernel state, not a production mp_physics configuration with RA37.

roster_and_controls.comparison: All CASE records include raw input/constants/radii as 19 REAL32 hex words. Returned CASE dictionary is exact between variants; fixture also compares input array bits before/after helper. ON observations must have all twelve unique IDs; OFF must have none.
roster_and_controls.repeat_modes: Cases11/12 repeat cases1/3 after the other modes and require exact CASE words, checking selected kernel-state leakage.
roster_and_controls.declared_child_budget: 22 compile/link +6 fixture processes +1 compiler version; 72 helper calls,24 ON cloud observations. Counts are source-derived here, not independently executed or attested by this review.

algebra_checks.Thompson: Native nv is fixed Nt_c when private aerosol flag is false, otherwise raw nc*rho with bounds. g_ratio(mu) equals (mu+1)(mu+2)(mu+3) for the selected integer shape; independent moment formula follows explicit spherical mass and generalized gamma assumptions: r_eff=(mu+3)/(2*lambda).
algebra_checks.UDM: Activity gate consumes nc*rho but lambda consumes raw nc. Oracle records this source distinction; its half-inverse slope is not relabeled as Thompson M3/(2M2).
algebra_checks.input_arms: Fixed raw number, matched thermodynamics/density, and explicit nc=rho*eta conditional UDM arm. The latter is an input hypothesis; no host conversion or physical population authority is inferred.
algebra_checks.clamps: Cloud-only positive mass/number, both observed number caps/floors and returned radius clamps required inactive. Missing ice/snow inputs do not claim those paths are validated.
algebra_checks.EOS: Manufactured pressure inverts the actual Thompson density expression; UDM receives the resulting same density. This is a kernel comparison, not a hydrostatic WRF column.

qualifications.evidence: Products and base division are rounded to REAL32, but slope=base**exponent uses Python binary64 pow, followed by binary64 final radius arithmetic. Thompson native REAL32 RHS is assigned to DOUBLE PRECISION lamc; final expression uses double then SNGL. UDM uses native reciprocal then product. Comparisons declare 2e-6/3e-6 relative bounds.
qualifications.required_wording: Bounded source-association/algebra comparison, not exact native-kind replay or independently established ULP equality. If exact-kinds validation is intended, add r32 power result and correct per-helper final-kind expression, and report measured bits/ULPs separately.

qualifications.evidence: Cases3/4 fixed-mass number density cancellation works because selected nv yields mu=15 in both cases. Thompson mu depends on nv, so a different density pair may change shape and radius despite cancellation in the cubic mass/number factor.
qualifications.required_wording: Cancellation in these selected equal-shape cases; do not generalize to all Thompson number/density inputs.

qualifications.evidence: CASE destructuring implicitly requires 19 values, but observation check indexes first six values without requiring exactly six. Current source hook emits exactly six and identities are unique.
qualifications.suggestion: Explicitly require len(x)==6 to make the observation schema a closed roster; this is not a demonstrated current fixture failure.

messages: Parent informed of native-kind replay and equal-shape cancellation limitations before this review was sealed.
